# Relevant class and role axioms from the normative Commons 1.3 ontologies:
# https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/20250801/Organizations.ttl
# https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/20250801/PartiesAndSituations.ttl
# https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/20250801/RolesAndCompositions.ttl
# The .txt suffix keeps test fixtures out of consumers' RDF file discovery.
@prefix org: <https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/Organizations/> .
@prefix pts: <https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/PartiesAndSituations/> .
@prefix role: <https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/RolesAndCompositions/> .
@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .

org:Organization rdfs:subClassOf pts:Party .
org:FormalOrganization rdfs:subClassOf org:Organization .
org:InformalOrganization rdfs:subClassOf org:Organization .
org:LegalEntity rdfs:subClassOf org:FormalOrganization , org:LegalPerson .
org:LegalPerson rdfs:subClassOf pts:Party .
org:OrganizationalSubUnit rdfs:subClassOf org:Organization .
pts:Party rdfs:subClassOf pts:Agent .
pts:Agent owl:disjointWith role:Role .
pts:PartyRole rdfs:subClassOf pts:AgentRole .
pts:AgentRole rdfs:subClassOf role:Role .
role:isPlayedBy a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:domain role:Role ;
    owl:inverseOf role:playsRole .
